name: Ben Talbot
source:
The descendant of a family cursed with lycanthropy, Ben was left in charge of his sisters after the death of their parents.

Loud and outgoing, Ben always seems to be in a good mood despite his numerous responsibilities. Because he's very overprotective, he tends to act like an older brother to his friends.

[Edited from [url=http://monstrousloversevn.tumblr.com/characters]official site[/url]]
